products.name: Alteryx AI
products.note: Analytics automation with AI; data blending; workflow governance; self-service analytics risk

profile_text.body:
Alteryx is a data and analytics company that describes itself as providing AI-ready analytics automation for enterprise organizations. Its flagship platform, Alteryx One, is positioned as a full-spectrum analytics solution that connects to sources such as ERPs, CRMs, data lakes, and files, and integrates with tools including Snowflake, Databricks, Oracle, and Microsoft products. The company claims the platform can prep and blend data up to 100x faster than manual methods and that predictive analytics automation can save up to 170 FTE hours a month.

Alteryx One combines predictive analytics, machine learning, and generative AI capabilities, and is designed to support low-code and no-code workflows with built-in governance, lineage tracking, and data preparation. The site highlights use cases at McLaren Racing, where the platform is used to collect and analyze on- and off-track data for race performance and car design, and at Nielsen, where it supported a business intelligence overhaul to broaden access to analytics automation. The company describes itself as rated a leader across multiple 2026 analyst evaluations for enterprise-scale analytics and AI.

The site's registered product tracked by this site is Alteryx AI, categorized under Data and Analytics AI, covering analytics automation, data blending, workflow governance, and self-service analytics. No litigation, SEC filings, MCP servers, or patent records are present in the held facts.
